title: Otori Emu — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?!
Emu, you became a class representative?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I did!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna do everything I can to fill my class with as many smiles as I can♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Emu as a class representative...
That sounds very fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Does it sound fun...?
Or does it sound like chaos...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Actually, you may be surprised.
Emu could actually excel at leading the class in an innovative way.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You really think so?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But you mustn't take this job lightly!
It involves squabbling with others constantly...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There may be times when you get wrapped up in heated discussions with your classmates that last all day! That's far from easy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Squabble? Heated discussions? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You may get into a few arguments.
From what I recall, Tsukasa's previous class was very active in that department...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That ball sports competition where the volleyball and baseball teams fought over players especially comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's definitely in the top three for toughest conflicts that I had to resolve as a class representative.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right. I forgot that you were a class representative until not too long ago.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm honestly still having trouble imagining you as one... Do you plan on giving it another go?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No!
For various reasons, I have decided to be a hall monitor this year.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
A hall monitor?!
You?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haha. It's just one surprise after another for you today, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Of course I'm surprised.
I mean, I never expected you to become a class rep or Tsukasa to become a hall monitor.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seriously, how were your classes okay with either of those things?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well...
A lot happened.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Very true.
It was quite the scene.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And who do you think is to blame?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe I should stop asking about this...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, Nene, Rui, you haven't told us which committee you're gonna be on yet!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I joined the library committee.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
That makes sense since you've been reading lots of books lately!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm just doing that to learn more about becoming a better stage performer. Besides, I didn't exactly volunteer...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
Aoyagi was there when I went to go meet the other committee members.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
Toya's going to be on the library committee again this year?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Interesting...
I didn't know that. He must really love books.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, when you say Toya, do you mean the one who was really good at video games?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's great, Nene! I bet you two will get a lot closer this year!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I dunno about that...
But I'm glad that someone I know is there.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, if Toya is around, you should have no problems!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, this conversation is making it feel like the new term has truly begun...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup!
We're in new classes and on new committees. It's like everything around us is sparkling!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait...
Rui, what committee did you end up going for?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's not new so it might not count as “sparkling,” but I've chosen to remain on the greening committee.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!
You must like it a lot, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Well...
It's not a committee that stands out very much, but the work is rewarding.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, there are some seeds that I planted that have yet to sprout.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It didn't feel right for me to leave before they had the chance to grow into flowers.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I didn't expect you to care for plants that much...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You don't even eat your veggies!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I said the same thing to him just the other day.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, let's leave it at that. I'm glad to hear that we all joined committees we can enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too!
And if I run into any trouble, I'm gonna ask you for help since you used to be a class rep, Tsukasa☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! Throw any questions you have my way!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Honestly, I'm not sure if you really wanna follow his example...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But as far as I could tell, his classmates seemed to hold him in very high regard.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, I'm gonna do my best to become a reliable class rep just like Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Class 2-B's gonna be so wonderhoy and full of smiles! I'll work hard to make this the most fun year ever☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Break a leg.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's our Emu for you.
I'll also be cheering you on.
